description: Import a template's roles, resources, forms and actions into the project `cwd` resolves to, for a first build: build it with the formio-resource-planner skill. Each form it names is replaced, its actions deleted and recreated, and its `access` replaces the project's; change an existing project with the form, role and action tools instead.

cwd.description: Optional. Directory whose project to use; defaults to the client's workspace root.

template.description: The template JSON object to import

name: project_import
